main_text.p: & vinum illud sint ipsum corpus & ipse sanguis Domini(quod ne Cossubstantiatio[?] quidé ipsa patitur)sed vt nouerimus in hac actio" ne non minus vere menti praeberi res significatas, quàm signa ori praebentur: ita quoque verba ACCIPITE,COMEDITE,BIBITE, interpretanda sunt: actionibus videlicet illis quæ proprie sunt corporeę,ad mentis & fidei spiritualem operationem, per metonymiam sacramentis conuenientissimam translatis.

Discipuli o-ralem po-tum san-guinis non agnouerut.Præterquàm quòd autem istis loquutioni-bus à corpore ad animum translatis nihil est, in sacris etiam literis, & in quotidiano sermone usitatius, rectè obseruat Chrysostomus discipulos propterea ad hunc Christi sermonem idcirco non exhorruisse, quòd hæc spiritualiter esse intelligenda ex eiusdem ore, Capernaitarum crassitiem reprehendentis, intellexissent: nunquam alioqui sanguinem contra tam expressum legis interdictum, ne cibo quidem permixtum sumpturi. Et, quæ-so, veteres illos Christianos, quibus immanis illa & Cyclopica,siue visibilis,siue inuisibilis, σαρκοφαγία obiiciebatur, quis absoluisset, si realem illam præsentiam & oralem manducationem approbassent?

Hyperbolæ patrum quor[?] sum usur-pata, & quo sensu accipieda[?].Non sunt igitur aliter quàm hæc ipsa Chri-sti verba accipiendæ orthodoxorum patrum hyperbolæ, veluti quum Corpus Domini in os nostrum intrare, & Lingua sanguine Christi in-cruentari, & ipsummet Christum in hac actione videri & tangi scribunt: nihil minùs profecto

page.notes: Running head and page number read clearly. Left margin notes: first note is "Discipuli o-/ralem po-/tum san-/guinis non agnouerut." (printed hyphens kept). Second note is hard to read: "quor" may be an abbreviation, "vsur" is printed with a special mark, and the last word "accipieda" is uncertain; marked with [?]. "Cossubstantiatio" in the first paragraph is uncertain (the letters after the C are blurred); marked [?]. Long s printed as s/ff ligature is transcribed as plain s. "quàm" at the bottom right is treated as catchword, not text. Greek σαρκοφαγία copied as printed. Printed quotation marks after "actio" and italics as shown.
